## TemplateEngine.\_processSpaceBlocks() method

Removes lines containing self-closing `<space />` tags.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processSpaceBlocks(template: string): string;
```

**Returns:**

string

The template with `<space />` lines removed

## Remarks

This internal method identifies lines that contain only a `<space />` tag (with optional surrounding whitespace) and removes the entire line. This is useful for controlling whitespace in templates.

\*\*Attributes:\*\* - none

## Example


```typescript
const template = 'Line 1\n<space />\nLine 2';
const processed = TemplateEngine._processSpaceBlocks(template);
// Result: 'Line 1\n\nLine 2'
```
